tier3_strict_report.important_negative_result: The old 55->95% VLM-coverage narrative was explicitly rejected for this Tier-3 strict-text measurement state.

later_working_paper.metric_warning: These numbers arise from later architecture/dictionary state and materially different coverage definitions; they do not supersede the May-26 negative results as if all metrics measured the same semantic capability.

reconciled_findings.finding: Retina capability claims must be metric-versioned. Strict lexical/text coverage, CLIP-assisted lenient coverage, dictionary-driven recall and actual compositional correctness are distinct observables and must never be collapsed into one accuracy number.

Historical Tier-3 failure modes include YOLO class-boundary misses, YOLO hallucinations on art/AI imagery, CLIP vocabulary gaps, OCR failure on painted/stylized text, lack of compositional binding and insufficient attribute/color detail. These are preserved as mandatory regression families rather than discarded by later higher aggregate coverage.

The learned dictionary materially improved historical phrase coverage, but dictionary/familiarity output is a prior/readout, not sensor truth. This directly supports the current FRANK v0.1 law familiarity != evidence and the Micro Visual Classifier role as routing/familiarity rather than semantic authority.

Every VisualPercept/Assembly should retain stage/source provenance, metric/calibration version and uncertainty so downstream FRANK can distinguish direct detections, similarity matches, dictionary priors, learned familiarity and generated captions.

Kandinsky->bed/false artist attribution demonstrates cascade amplification: an upstream detector hallucination can become a fluent region caption. FRANK must propagate contradiction/low-confidence state and allow downstream veto/escalation instead of converting every stage output into declarative fact.

Current Harness Retina tests should preserve historical hard families: abstract art, AI chimeras, ancient artifacts, photojournalism, concept mashups, stylized text, open-set objects, wrong-base-class region captions and relation/composition queries.

frank: Keep dissolved Retina multimodal path mandatory.
Represent perception as evidence with provenance/uncertainty rather than a single textual description.
Treat familiarity/dictionary/MVC state as routing prior, never truth.
harness: Add metric-versioned regression runs separating strict-text, semantic/embedding recall and task-success measures.
Include historical failure images/families and cascade-hallucination tests.
Require contradiction propagation and deep-perception escalation on detector/caption conflict.
claycode: Ensure IR can encode percept source, calibration/version, confidence/open-set state, contradiction and evidence tier without flattening to text.
claygraph: Persist source-stage edges and contradictory percept candidates as separate graph facts/hypotheses with lineage.
unifieddb: Persist metric/calibration/version identities for visual learner/dictionary states and keep learned familiarity separate from sensor evidence.
gwt: Workspace ignition should be able to select a percept hypothesis while retaining competing percepts and their uncertainty/provenance for re-entry.
emergenz: Do not count metric inflation or dictionary recall as evidence of emergent visual understanding without lesion/ablation and compositional tests.
hyperposition: Model mutually incompatible visual interpretations as alternatives until evidence resolves them rather than prematurely collapsing them.
clay: Retina should dissolve into the shared state substrate as typed evidence fields, not survive as a textual black-box microservice.
